cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get us to the wedding. Keep the hall key away from that cup of tea; the address is on the invitation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The key fell in. I used the invitation to dry it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clean the key. You read out the address before the paper tears.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The address has washed off. The paper's stuck to the key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the whole mess in the cup and call the couple. I'll explain why we've got their key but nowhere to take it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes trip control; A3 splits salvage tasks; A5 accepts need for the couple help after the returning key/cup/invitation chain defeats departure.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 drying makes A3 key cleaning/address reading necessary; B4 address loss causes A5 call, but putting the mess into tea repeats avoidable damage.

relationship.evidence: B4 supplies the actual limit on A3 salvage plan, not a gratuitous question.

heightening.evidence: A5 unifies damaged objects and lost navigation into a necessary call, but the cup should be emptied explicitly.

specificity.evidence: A1 cup contains tea and no later turn removes it before A5 storage proposal.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 nowhere-to-take-it explanation can give way to a direct address request after safe storage.
